_comment: Published gate records carrying a verdict their gate's CURRENT rules would not issue (vibe-ic#510). MAY ONLY SHRINK. Correcting one is the benchmark-agent's commit under NO-MIX — results and plugin fixes never share a commit — so they are recorded here, not silently fixed by the plugin that found them.
scope_expanded: The dfm_screen_check re-adjudication rule was registered for the first time in v1.8.75, so published dfm_screen records that no rule had ever reached are adjudicated here for the first time: three carry a plain PASS beside VIA_DEFS_NOT_FOUND, i.e. a via screen that never examined a via. That is newly-adjudicated SCOPE, not the corpus getting worse. Correcting a published record is the benchmark-agent commit under NO-MIX, so they are recorded rather than edited. The growth itself landed in 501294fd, which recorded previous_size 2 -> 5 but left this reason in prose the program cannot read; vibe-ic#922 transcribes it into the field the ratchet reads.
